q: Why does a 10-bit export help with gradients?
a: 8-bit has 256 steps per channel and soft gradients show them after compression. Export H.265 with the Main 10 profile (HDR sequences use it automatically).

q: What goes wrong when I upload an already heavily compressed file to YouTube?
a: YouTube compresses it again, so you get compression on compression. Upload a high-bitrate or constant-quality (CRF) 4K H.265 file instead.
